title: RoboForce, which is developing robotics systems to perform physically demanding industrial work, raised $52M led by YZi Labs, bringing its total funding to $67M (Duncan Riley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Duncan Riley / SiliconANGLE: RoboForce, which is developing robotics systems to perform physically demanding industrial work, raised $52M led by YZi Labs, bringing its total funding to $67M — Robotics startup RoboForce Inc. announced today that it has raised $52 million in new funding to accelerate …
